title: Leetcodify Friends Recommendations
summary: Recommend two users to each other when they are not friends and share at least three distinct songs listened to on the same day.
outputFormat: Directed user_id / recommended_id pairs without duplicates.
edgeRules: Common listening on different days does not count.
